items.title: Drupal 7 LTSR 7.2026.01 Released
items.content_html:
Drupal 7 LTSR (Long Term Support Release) 7.2026.01 is now available. This is the first LTSR release, providing extended security support for Drupal 7 sites beyond the official EOL date of January 5, 2025.

Key features:

  • PHP 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, and 8.3 support
  • Security hardening (gadget chain mitigation)
  • Self-hosted update channel
  • 20 contrib modules with LTSR support

Learn more and download

items.title: Welcome to Drupal 7 LTSR
items.content_html:
Drupal 7 LTSR provides Long Term Support for organizations that need to continue running Drupal 7 beyond the official end-of-life. LTSR includes:

  • Extended Security Updates (ESU) - Critical security patches
  • PHP 8.x Compatibility - Support for modern PHP versions
  • Modernization - UI improvements and module integrations over time

For questions or to contribute, visit our GitHub repository.
